about.text: A lactitol laxative sold as a powder in 10 g sachets that is dissolved in water; in France it is licensed for the symptomatic treatment of constipation and for hepatic encephalopathy. The marketing authorisation holder in France is Angelini Pharma (Rome), distributed by SERB. Wikipedia lists it as the trade name of lactitol in Europe.

links.name: Vidal: Importal 10 g, poudre pour solution buvable en sachet

how.text: Made like any lactitol: lactose from whey permeate is hydrogenated over a nickel catalyst; the crystals are then packed as unit-dose sachets. Nothing further is done to the sugar alcohol.
